facts.fact: 比剑室风波当晚，Gabriel 没带 Rory 回卧室收拾赴晚宴，而是把她领进一间摆着大书桌、书架、插满彩色图钉的 Tironaill 地图和玻璃柜武器的书房单独谈话。
facts.anchor: A portrait of a battle between what looked to be seraphs hung in the hallway beside the solid oak door that stood before us. I thought Gabriel would lead me back to my bedchamber to clean up and ready for dinner, but he guided me into a spacious office.

facts.fact: Gabriel 为在比剑室发火向 Rory 道歉，说是以为 Darragh 在伤害她；Rory 发誓没有那回事——袭击之后是她主动求 Darragh 教她，Darragh 对她一直很好。
facts.anchor: “Rory, I wanted to talk with you about what happened in the sparring room.” He ran his fingers through his hair and released a deep breath. “I apologize for losing my temper, but I thought he was hurting you.”

facts.fact: Gabriel 断言 Darragh「不像我们、不可信」，好心是让她放松警惕的伪装；Rory 追问「不像我们」是指 angheals 吗，Gabriel 予以承认。
facts.anchor: “Not like us? You mean angheals?” I tipped my head, and my eyebrows shot up.

facts.fact: Rory 以自己也不是 seraph 反将一军（「那我也不可信吗」），Gabriel 闪电般冲到椅前、双手扣住椅两侧把她困在椅中，俯身到眼前警告她：Darragh 善操纵、能瞬间变换性格，她看到的都是他想让她看到的。
facts.anchor: Gabriel’s mouth hung open. He was in front of me in a flash, both hands grasping each side of the chair, caging me in.

facts.fact: Gabriel 自述过去一年持续向 Themis 祈祷求一位命中注定的人，还多次在其祭坛献血，认定如今终于得到「祝福」；Rory 内心惊慌，慌乱回避他的目光。
facts.anchor: I have been praying to Themis steadily this past year to bring someone into my life who is meant for me. Someone who isn’t like the rest of the noblewomen in this land. I have shed a lot of my blood at his altar.

facts.fact: Gabriel 摊牌：想说服 Rory 和 Cora 留在 Tironaill，许诺城堡安全、什么都不缺，日后可「超越友谊」、打破旧偏见，并视之为 Themis 的安排；Rory 反问破除偏见何须专挑人类，他随即单膝跪下拉住她的手，要她答应「考虑留下」。
facts.anchor: I said that I was hoping to convince you and Cora to stay here in Tironaill. You would be safe at the castle, of course, and you would want for nothing.

facts.fact: 为不被看穿恐慌，Rory 目光落到桌边一本老旧开裂的皮面书上，书脊褪色字母拼出 MEAD；她推测这不是 Psilas 的那本书，但疑心顿起。
facts.anchor: In my haste to keep him from reading me, my gaze fell onto an old, cracked leather-bound book lying off to the side of the desk. Faded lettering on the spine spelled MEAD.

facts.fact: Gabriel 解释这本制蜜酒的书是从西谷（West Valley）新押回的一名民兵身上没收的，他正在检查书里有没有密码——他们此前曾在书、信甚至诗里破译出阴谋。
facts.anchor: Hardly. I confiscated it from one of the militia members we just brought back from the West Valley. I have to check it to make sure no coded language in here could lead us to more locations or militia sympathizer names.

facts.fact: Gabriel 说西边行动抓到几名躲在森林里的民兵、晚饭后亲自审讯；Rory 切回甜美贵族腔谎称只是担心他安危，顺势约他明天陪自己去市场那家面包店，并答应了「考虑留下」——她打算把这个空承诺尽量演下去，绝不让 Gabriel 知道她在找回家的路。
facts.anchor: We were able to bring in a few militia members hiding out in the forest. I will be questioning them after dinner. Why do you ask?
